compliance.NOT_ASSESSED: No completed applicability and performance assessment.
compliance.AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED: Controlling adopted authority or its applicable effect remains unresolved.
compliance.NOT_APPLICABLE: A source-linked applicability assessment excludes the entity/action/period; not a performance finding.
compliance.NOT_YET_DUE: A sourced prospective deadline has not elapsed at the evidence cutoff; no implication of completed performance.
compliance.EVIDENCE_MISSING: Evidence is inadequate to adjudicate applicable performance; not a finding of noncompliance.
compliance.COMPLIANT_VERIFIED: Applicable adopted obligation and sufficient scoped performance/coverage evidence have been reviewed.
compliance.NONCOMPLIANT_VERIFIED: Applicable adopted obligation, elapsed sourced deadline, and sufficient scoped evidence of nonperformance have been reviewed.

implementation.NOT_ASSESSED: Implementation evidence has not been assessed.
implementation.REPORTED: An identified source reports implementation; independent verification is not asserted.
implementation.PARTIALLY_VERIFIED: Evidence verifies specified components while material components remain unverified.
implementation.VERIFIED: Evidence verifies all material components in the explicitly bounded scope.

rules: Source publication, adoption, implementation, compliance, candidate maturity and benefit realization are separate axes.
An adopted recommendation is not automatically a mandatory direction.
A proposal or advisory recommendation cannot supply governing adoption.
A reported organizational arrangement cannot establish actual incremental financial benefit.
No monetary finding is savings before FINANCIALLY_VALIDATED.
Null deadlines and missing evidence never support NONCOMPLIANT_VERIFIED.
NOT_YET_DUE requires an explicit sourced deadline later than the evidence cutoff.
NOT_APPLICABLE requires an explicit applicability assessment receipt.
limitations: A vocabulary is not an applicability, legal, operational or financial adjudication.
